name: Playwright-style browser automation API for Chrome extensions

mentions.name: Playwright-style browser automation API for Chrome extensions
mentions.description: A library that reimplements the Puppeteer/Playwright client API on top of native Chrome extension APIs, enabling browser automation to run inside a Chrome extension without the Chrome DevTools Protocol. Chrome extension APIs cover roughly 85% of CDP/Webdriver BiDi functionality (e.g., calling functions with chrome.scripting.executeScript() instead of script.callFunction) while preserving security features that shouldn't be bypassed; a proof of concept is planned in 2-3 weeks.
mentions.problem: Running Playwright inside a Chrome extension currently requires the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) to automate a browser, which hurts the user experience, is very slow, and opens security vulnerabilities.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm copying the Puppeteer / Playwright client API to run in a Chrome extension using the native Chrome extension APIs.
